title: Tsaftace bayanai, da'awar gaskiya da ma'auni masu mahimmanci
course_title: Karatun Bayanai: Fayil ɗin Jarida, Charts da Ma'aunin Kasuwanci

say: Tsaftace bayanai, da'awar gaskiya, da ma'auni masu mahimmanci.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don module 3 na Ilimin Bayanai.

Bayanai na gaskiya ba safai ba ne mai tsabta. Mutane suna bugawa da sauri, mutane biyu suna yin rikodin tallace-tallace iri ɗaya, ana ƙara sifili bisa kuskure. Jeri ɗaya da ba daidai ba zai iya canza jimla ko yanke shawara.

say: Bayanai na iya zama daidai amma ana amfani da su da kyau: fallasa bayanan sirri, ko tura mai karatu zuwa ga ƙarshe mara kyau.

say: Babban tallace-tallace baya bada garantin riba. Alkaluman Ada suna misalai ne.

card.title: Watan Satumba Ada ta yi riba?
card.note: Figures masu kwatanta. Jimlar riba ce ta tara.

say: Kudaden shiga idan aka cire farashin kayan da ake sayarwa, babban riba ne: Naira 110,000. Raba ta hanyar kudaden shiga da lokuta 100, kuma jigon ta shine 27.5%.

card.title: Watan Satumba Ada ta yi riba?
card.note: Figures masu kwatanta. Jimlar riba ce ta tara.

say: Bayan naira 20,000 na kudin tafiyar da aikinta, ribar da ta samu ya kai 90,000, ragi mai kashi 22.5%.
Idan mai sayar da ita ya yi tsada kuma ba ta daidaita ba, za ta fara ganinsa a cikin faɗuwar babbar riba.

card.title: Watan Satumba Ada ta yi riba?
card.note: Figures masu kwatanta. Jimlar riba ce ta tara.

say: Break- even shine inda zaku biya duk farashi. Dan kasuwa yana da kayyade farashin Naira 20,000 a wata. Kowane bokitin garri ya bar naira 500, don haka 20,000 kaso 500 guga 40 ne.

panel.heading: Guga nawa za ta sayar?

say: Idan kudin ya kai 2,200, kowane guga ya bar 300 kawai, kuma tana buƙatar kusan guga 67. Shi ya sa biyan biyan kuɗi yana da mahimmanci kamar bin diddigin tallace-tallace.

panel.heading: Guga nawa za ta sayar?

say: Don tunawa. Tsaftace kafin ku ƙidaya. Kare mutane da bayar da rahoto na gaskiya. Kuma waƙa da lambobi masu mahimmanci 3 zuwa 5 kowane mako, gami da gefe, ba kawai tallace-tallace ba.

Daidaitawa alama ce, ba hujja ba
Babban riba = babban riba ÷ kudaden shiga × 100
